newsitem.title: USA: Enron says Portland to get 1 mln fewer shrs.
newsitem.headline: Enron says Portland to get 1 mln fewer shrs.

text.p: As a result of changes to the terms of the merger between Enron Corp and Portland General Corp shareholders, Portland shareholders will receive some one million fewer Enron shares if they vote in favour of the merger.
"The deal will comprise around 50 million Enron shares, around one million less than the original deal," Ken Lay, Enron's chief executive told a conference call.

Enron said on Monday that it and Portland would increase benefits to Oregon electricity consumers by $141 million and, as a result, Portland shareholders would receive 0.9875 Enron shares for each of their own shares instead of one for one.
Lay said that the deal would still be valued at around $3.0 billion.
He said that the companies had based their proposals on the Oregon Public Utilities Commission staff report on the merger, which had demanded higher benefits for electricity consumers in the state.
